meta.title: Long Night's End
meta.description: Let's have some supper before going to bed!

units.rawText: Wait, wait a minute... You, you're going too fast! (pants heavily)
units.displayText: Wait, wait a minute... You, you're going too fast! (pants heavily)

spans.text: Wait, wait a minute... You, you're going too fast! (pants heavily)

units.rawText: I tracked them all the way here based on info from the Professor, but am I going to lose them again—
units.displayText: I tracked them all the way here based on info from the Professor, but am I going to lose them again—

spans.text: I tracked them all the way here based on info from the Professor, but am I going to lose them again—

units.rawText: Vrmmm...
units.displayText: Vrmmm...

spans.text: Vrmmm...

units.rawText: Where on earth did the three of them go...
units.displayText: Where on earth did the three of them go...

spans.text: Where on earth did the three of them go...

units.rawText: Boom—
units.displayText: Boom—

spans.text: Boom—

units.rawText: What?!
units.displayText: What?!

spans.text: What?!

units.rawText: Before Cascadia can tell what that loud crash is, a brilliant flare of light suddenly erupts from the distance, swallowing up its surroundings.
units.displayText: Before Cascadia can tell what that loud crash is, a brilliant flare of light suddenly erupts from the distance, swallowing up its surroundings.

spans.text: Before Cascadia can tell what that loud crash is, a brilliant flare of light suddenly erupts from the distance, swallowing up its surroundings.

units.rawText: Following the loud noise, the light fades, along with the dust and smoke that it threw up.
units.displayText: Following the loud noise, the light fades, along with the dust and smoke that it threw up.

spans.text: Following the loud noise, the light fades, along with the dust and smoke that it threw up.

units.rawText: Oh no, those are the temporary buildings over there that were scheduled for demolition. If they collapse...
units.displayText: Oh no, those are the temporary buildings over there that were scheduled for demolition. If they collapse...

spans.text: Oh no, those are the temporary buildings over there that were scheduled for demolition. If they collapse...

units.rawText: I need to get there now!
units.displayText: I need to get there now!

spans.text: I need to get there now!

units.rawText: (Coughs) Looks like the buildings have already collapsed, and there's no sign of them...
units.displayText: (Coughs) Looks like the buildings have already collapsed, and there's no sign of them...

spans.text: (Coughs) Looks like the buildings have already collapsed, and there's no sign of them...

units.rawText: Dammit... Looks like they've been buried by the rubble. They're causing so much trouble after they transformed!
units.displayText: Dammit... Looks like they've been buried by the rubble. They're causing so much trouble after they transformed!

spans.text: Dammit... Looks like they've been buried by the rubble. They're causing so much trouble after they transformed!

units.rawText: Cascadia comes to a halt and takes a deep breath before doing a quick gear check on herself.
units.displayText: Cascadia comes to a halt and takes a deep breath before doing a quick gear check on herself.

spans.text: Cascadia comes to a halt and takes a deep breath before doing a quick gear check on herself.

units.rawText: Sensors check, demolition gear check, demolition hammer check... Okay, looks like my equipment's fine.
units.displayText: Sensors check, demolition gear check, demolition hammer check... Okay, looks like my equipment's fine.

spans.text: Sensors check, demolition gear check, demolition hammer check... Okay, looks like my equipment's fine.

units.rawText: Slo-Mo, prepare for rescue!
units.displayText: Slo-Mo, prepare for rescue!

spans.text: Slo-Mo, prepare for rescue!

units.rawText: Vrmmmm...
units.displayText: Vrmmmm...

spans.text: Vrmmmm...

units.rawText: Some time later, Cascadia finally spots a familiar figure.
units.displayText: Some time later, Cascadia finally spots a familiar figure.

spans.text: Some time later, Cascadia finally spots a familiar figure.

units.rawText: Sockdolager and Fern... Thank goodness, their vital signs are stable and they aren't in danger for now.
units.displayText: Sockdolager and Fern... Thank goodness, their vital signs are stable and they aren't in danger for now.

spans.text: Sockdolager and Fern... Thank goodness, their vital signs are stable and they aren't in danger for now.

units.rawText: That leaves Chanzhi. Her signal's stable, so I'm sure she'll be fine, too!
units.displayText: That leaves Chanzhi. Her signal's stable, so I'm sure she'll be fine, too!

spans.text: That leaves Chanzhi. Her signal's stable, so I'm sure she'll be fine, too!

units.rawText: Cascadia arduously climbs up a pile of rubble that her signal is emanating from. She sticks to its edges, giving Chanzhi as much room to move as she can manage.
units.displayText: Cascadia arduously climbs up a pile of rubble that her signal is emanating from. She sticks to its edges, giving Chanzhi as much room to move as she can manage.

spans.text: Cascadia arduously climbs up a pile of rubble that her signal is emanating from. She sticks to its edges, giving Chanzhi as much room to move as she can manage.

units.rawText: Alright! And now—
units.displayText: Alright! And now—

spans.text: Alright! And now—

units.rawText: Is... is that you...
units.displayText: Is... is that you...

spans.text: Is... is that you...

units.rawText: Chanzhi? Are you awake? Don't talk for now, I'll get you out of there first! I'm almost there, I just need to clear the stuff under you!
units.displayText: Chanzhi? Are you awake? Don't talk for now, I'll get you out of there first! I'm almost there, I just need to clear the stuff under you!

spans.text: Chanzhi? Are you awake? Don't talk for now, I'll get you out of there first! I'm almost there, I just need to clear the stuff under you!

units.rawText: Cascadia suddenly lurches upward but plants her foot on an unstable ledge, which gives way beneath her with a creak.
units.displayText: Cascadia suddenly lurches upward but plants her foot on an unstable ledge, which gives way beneath her with a creak.

spans.text: Cascadia suddenly lurches upward but plants her foot on an unstable ledge, which gives way beneath her with a creak.

units.rawText: Ah... Look out!
units.displayText: Ah... Look out!

spans.text: Ah... Look out!

units.rawText: Just as Cascadia is about to fall, a gold-edged ribbon swirls out of Chanzhi's hand and neatly catches her.
units.displayText: Just as Cascadia is about to fall, a gold-edged ribbon swirls out of Chanzhi's hand and neatly catches her.

spans.text: Just as Cascadia is about to fall, a gold-edged ribbon swirls out of Chanzhi's hand and neatly catches her.

units.rawText: What... What's this? Is this one of Chanzhi's ribbons? Is it... wrapped around something?
units.displayText: What... What's this? Is this one of Chanzhi's ribbons? Is it... wrapped around something?

spans.text: What... What's this? Is this one of Chanzhi's ribbons? Is it... wrapped around something?

units.rawText: Cascadia uses it to steady herself and finds her footing again.
units.displayText: Cascadia uses it to steady herself and finds her footing again.

spans.text: Cascadia uses it to steady herself and finds her footing again.

units.rawText: Is this... That sword from before?
units.displayText: Is this... That sword from before?

spans.text: Is this... That sword from before?

units.rawText: Right, this isn't the time! I need to get Chanzhi out of there and confirm her vital signs!
units.displayText: Right, this isn't the time! I need to get Chanzhi out of there and confirm her vital signs!

spans.text: Right, this isn't the time! I need to get Chanzhi out of there and confirm her vital signs!

units.rawText: Cascadia rushes over to Chanzhi's side, quickly sweeping away the debris covering her and scooping her out of there.
units.displayText: Cascadia rushes over to Chanzhi's side, quickly sweeping away the debris covering her and scooping her out of there.

spans.text: Cascadia rushes over to Chanzhi's side, quickly sweeping away the debris covering her and scooping her out of there.

units.rawText: So she passed out, huh... As for her vital signs and wounds...
units.displayText: So she passed out, huh... As for her vital signs and wounds...

spans.text: So she passed out, huh... As for her vital signs and wounds...

units.rawText: Don't worry, she should be fine.
units.displayText: Don't worry, she should be fine.

spans.text: Don't worry, she should be fine.

units.rawText: Who's that?
units.displayText: Who's that?

spans.text: Who's that?

units.rawText: It's me. I'm Fern, the archaeologist who found that sword in the first place.
units.displayText: It's me. I'm Fern, the archaeologist who found that sword in the first place.

spans.text: It's me. I'm Fern, the archaeologist who found that sword in the first place.

units.rawText: Huh, Fern? Did you finally come to your senses? You were going on and on about your guardian's geis just now!
units.displayText: Huh, Fern? Did you finally come to your senses? You were going on and on about your guardian's geis just now!

spans.text: Huh, Fern? Did you finally come to your senses? You were going on and on about your guardian's geis just now!

units.rawText: Ahem... Let's leave that aside for the moment. In any case, we should be fine, so don't worry.
units.displayText: Ahem... Let's leave that aside for the moment. In any case, we should be fine, so don't worry.

spans.text: Ahem... Let's leave that aside for the moment. In any case, we should be fine, so don't worry.

units.rawText: Also, er... It seems the artifact I found caused a lot of trouble, and it seems I did some really crazy stuff when I was a mythical character...
units.displayText: Also, er... It seems the artifact I found caused a lot of trouble, and it seems I did some really crazy stuff when I was a mythical character...

spans.text: Also, er... It seems the artifact I found caused a lot of trouble, and it seems I did some really crazy stuff when I was a mythical character...

units.rawText: Ahem... Well, you WERE flying all over the place.
units.displayText: Ahem... Well, you WERE flying all over the place.

spans.text: Ahem... Well, you WERE flying all over the place.

units.rawText: Uwaaahhhh, I'm so sorry! I don't know where to start apologizing...
units.displayText: Uwaaahhhh, I'm so sorry! I don't know where to start apologizing...

spans.text: Uwaaahhhh, I'm so sorry! I don't know where to start apologizing...

units.rawText: Still, there wasn't much harm done since these buildings were scheduled for demolition anyway. More importantly, you're all safe, which puts me at ease.
units.displayText: Still, there wasn't much harm done since these buildings were scheduled for demolition anyway. More importantly, you're all safe, which puts me at ease.

spans.text: Still, there wasn't much harm done since these buildings were scheduled for demolition anyway. More importantly, you're all safe, which puts me at ease.

units.rawText: Ugh... Who's there...
units.displayText: Ugh... Who's there...

spans.text: Ugh... Who's there...

units.rawText: Oh, seems Sockdolager's come to her senses as well. Her projection should soon follow.
units.displayText: Oh, seems Sockdolager's come to her senses as well. Her projection should soon follow.

spans.text: Oh, seems Sockdolager's come to her senses as well. Her projection should soon follow.

units.rawText: My neural cloud data feels a little messy... Huh, where's Hobbie?
units.displayText: My neural cloud data feels a little messy... Huh, where's Hobbie?

spans.text: My neural cloud data feels a little messy... Huh, where's Hobbie?

units.rawText: Chirp-chirp!
units.displayText: Chirp-chirp!

spans.text: Chirp-chirp!

units.rawText: Thank goodness! I finally found you, I'm so glad you're okay!
units.displayText: Thank goodness! I finally found you, I'm so glad you're okay!

spans.text: Thank goodness! I finally found you, I'm so glad you're okay!

units.rawText: Cascadia and Fern can't help smiling as they see Sockdolager's pet falcon fly back to her.
units.displayText: Cascadia and Fern can't help smiling as they see Sockdolager's pet falcon fly back to her.

spans.text: Cascadia and Fern can't help smiling as they see Sockdolager's pet falcon fly back to her.

units.rawText: Still, what on earth happened to you guys back there? You turned into mythological characters or something.
units.displayText: Still, what on earth happened to you guys back there? You turned into mythological characters or something.

spans.text: Still, what on earth happened to you guys back there? You turned into mythological characters or something.

units.rawText: Er... How shall I say this... Simply put, that sword contained data related to mythos and after Chanzhi's operands activated it, that data temporarily overwrote us.
units.displayText: Er... How shall I say this... Simply put, that sword contained data related to mythos and after Chanzhi's operands activated it, that data temporarily overwrote us.

spans.text: Er... How shall I say this... Simply put, that sword contained data related to mythos and after Chanzhi's operands activated it, that data temporarily overwrote us.

units.rawText: I see, so that's why Hobbie and the rest of us ended up with changed neural projections and neural cloud data. We quite literally weren't ourselves.
units.displayText: I see, so that's why Hobbie and the rest of us ended up with changed neural projections and neural cloud data. We quite literally weren't ourselves.

spans.text: I see, so that's why Hobbie and the rest of us ended up with changed neural projections and neural cloud data. We quite literally weren't ourselves.

units.rawText: <size=28>Um... What, what exactly did I do just now?</size>
units.displayText: Um... What, what exactly did I do just now?

spans.text: Um... What, what exactly did I do just now?

units.rawText: Chanzhi? Are you okay? Great, the readouts are saying that all your vitals are stable. Honestly, you gave me such a scare! Do you remember what happened just now?
units.displayText: Chanzhi? Are you okay? Great, the readouts are saying that all your vitals are stable. Honestly, you gave me such a scare! Do you remember what happened just now?

spans.text: Chanzhi? Are you okay? Great, the readouts are saying that all your vitals are stable. Honestly, you gave me such a scare! Do you remember what happened just now?

units.rawText: Um, Cascadia? What happened...
units.displayText: Um, Cascadia? What happened...

spans.text: Um, Cascadia? What happened...

units.rawText: Uwah? I think it's coming back to me now? Ahhhhhh... how could I have done all that? Did I cause problems for everyone AGAIN?
units.displayText: Uwah? I think it's coming back to me now? Ahhhhhh... how could I have done all that? Did I cause problems for everyone AGAIN?

spans.text: Uwah? I think it's coming back to me now? Ahhhhhh... how could I have done all that? Did I cause problems for everyone AGAIN?

units.rawText: Not really. What's important is that you're okay.
units.displayText: Not really. What's important is that you're okay.

spans.text: Not really. What's important is that you're okay.

units.rawText: (Whimper) None of this would have happened if I hadn't gone to grab that sword.
units.displayText: (Whimper) None of this would have happened if I hadn't gone to grab that sword.

spans.text: (Whimper) None of this would have happened if I hadn't gone to grab that sword.

units.rawText: It's not your fault! If Hobbie hadn't been influenced by the sword and flown around everywhere with it...
units.displayText: It's not your fault! If Hobbie hadn't been influenced by the sword and flown around everywhere with it...

spans.text: It's not your fault! If Hobbie hadn't been influenced by the sword and flown around everywhere with it...

units.rawText: The responsibility is mine. I found the sword, and I didn't expect something like this to happen. I'm the one to blame!
units.displayText: The responsibility is mine. I found the sword, and I didn't expect something like this to happen. I'm the one to blame!

spans.text: The responsibility is mine. I found the sword, and I didn't expect something like this to happen. I'm the one to blame!

units.rawText: In that case, I have to take some responsibility, too. If I hadn't spent so much time looking for the dust cover material at the bottom of my lockbox and come back earlier, I might have been able to prevent you guys from transforming.
units.displayText: In that case, I have to take some responsibility, too. If I hadn't spent so much time looking for the dust cover material at the bottom of my lockbox and come back earlier, I might have been able to prevent you guys from transforming.

spans.text: In that case, I have to take some responsibility, too. If I hadn't spent so much time looking for the dust cover material at the bottom of my lockbox and come back earlier, I might have been able to prevent you guys from transforming.

units.rawText: Huh? But, but that's not what I meant! I'm not trying to blame you or anything!
units.displayText: Huh? But, but that's not what I meant! I'm not trying to blame you or anything!

spans.text: Huh? But, but that's not what I meant! I'm not trying to blame you or anything!

units.rawText: In that case, you shouldn't blame yourself so much either, since it was all an accident in the first place.
units.displayText: In that case, you shouldn't blame yourself so much either, since it was all an accident in the first place.

spans.text: In that case, you shouldn't blame yourself so much either, since it was all an accident in the first place.

units.rawText: And besides, I wouldn't have been able to experience the artifact's power without this encounter, or gain so much first-hand research data.
units.displayText: And besides, I wouldn't have been able to experience the artifact's power without this encounter, or gain so much first-hand research data.

spans.text: And besides, I wouldn't have been able to experience the artifact's power without this encounter, or gain so much first-hand research data.

units.rawText: So it was actually a blessing in disguise, then? Hehehe, that's good, too.
units.displayText: So it was actually a blessing in disguise, then? Hehehe, that's good, too.

spans.text: So it was actually a blessing in disguise, then? Hehehe, that's good, too.

units.rawText: Also, Chanzhi, I'd have fallen and gotten hurt if you hadn't caught me just now. So stop blaming yourself for all this, okay?
units.displayText: Also, Chanzhi, I'd have fallen and gotten hurt if you hadn't caught me just now. So stop blaming yourself for all this, okay?

spans.text: Also, Chanzhi, I'd have fallen and gotten hurt if you hadn't caught me just now. So stop blaming yourself for all this, okay?

units.rawText: Research data like this is really rare. Ah, but if you want me to thank you with a meal, I'll have to ask you to let me off; I'm really short on cash.
units.displayText: Research data like this is really rare. Ah, but if you want me to thank you with a meal, I'll have to ask you to let me off; I'm really short on cash.

spans.text: Research data like this is really rare. Ah, but if you want me to thank you with a meal, I'll have to ask you to let me off; I'm really short on cash.

units.rawText: Pffft... Hahaha, alright, I understand. Thank you all. Still, I'll make sure I won't cause you guys any more problems!
units.displayText: Pffft... Hahaha, alright, I understand. Thank you all. Still, I'll make sure I won't cause you guys any more problems!

spans.text: Pffft... Hahaha, alright, I understand. Thank you all. Still, I'll make sure I won't cause you guys any more problems!

units.rawText: How about I buy you all dinner afterwards? I'm feeling a little low on energy after transforming for so long.
units.displayText: How about I buy you all dinner afterwards? I'm feeling a little low on energy after transforming for so long.

spans.text: How about I buy you all dinner afterwards? I'm feeling a little low on energy after transforming for so long.

units.rawText: Wow! This must be my lucky day! I haven't had a good meal in forever! At last, I don't have to calculate every single cent I spend on food!
units.displayText: Wow! This must be my lucky day! I haven't had a good meal in forever! At last, I don't have to calculate every single cent I spend on food!

spans.text: Wow! This must be my lucky day! I haven't had a good meal in forever! At last, I don't have to calculate every single cent I spend on food!

units.rawText: Heh, just think of it as a celebration of the incident ending well and as compensation for the whole thing.
units.displayText: Heh, just think of it as a celebration of the incident ending well and as compensation for the whole thing.

spans.text: Heh, just think of it as a celebration of the incident ending well and as compensation for the whole thing.

units.rawText: Also, we got new neural projections, too. They feel great, and yours suits you very well, Chanzhi.
units.displayText: Also, we got new neural projections, too. They feel great, and yours suits you very well, Chanzhi.

spans.text: Also, we got new neural projections, too. They feel great, and yours suits you very well, Chanzhi.

units.rawText: That's right! You were totes awesome when you saved me just now! Plus, these floaty ribbons suit you really well!
units.displayText: That's right! You were totes awesome when you saved me just now! Plus, these floaty ribbons suit you really well!

spans.text: That's right! You were totes awesome when you saved me just now! Plus, these floaty ribbons suit you really well!

units.rawText: You think so? Teehee, I'm feeling a little embarrassed now.
units.displayText: You think so? Teehee, I'm feeling a little embarrassed now.

spans.text: You think so? Teehee, I'm feeling a little embarrassed now.

units.rawText: You should take good care of them, then. If possible, I'd like to see what these ribbons look like as they flutter through the air. It's like your embroidery came to life.
units.displayText: You should take good care of them, then. If possible, I'd like to see what these ribbons look like as they flutter through the air. It's like your embroidery came to life.

spans.text: You should take good care of them, then. If possible, I'd like to see what these ribbons look like as they flutter through the air. It's like your embroidery came to life.

units.rawText: Hehe. You mean like this? Let me see—
units.displayText: Hehe. You mean like this? Let me see—

spans.text: Hehe. You mean like this? Let me see—

units.rawText: U-Uwah!
units.displayText: U-Uwah!

spans.text: U-Uwah!

units.rawText: As Chanzhi tries to move the ribbons, she loses her balance and stumbles.
units.displayText: As Chanzhi tries to move the ribbons, she loses her balance and stumbles.

spans.text: As Chanzhi tries to move the ribbons, she loses her balance and stumbles.

units.rawText: Chanzhi?!
units.displayText: Chanzhi?!

spans.text: Chanzhi?!

units.rawText: Thunk—there is a dull thud of her kicking something and everyone's heart lurches.
units.displayText: Thunk—there is a dull thud of her kicking something and everyone's heart lurches.

spans.text: Thunk—there is a dull thud of her kicking something and everyone's heart lurches.

units.rawText: That's—
units.displayText: That's—

spans.text: That's—

units.rawText: She, she kicked it! She kicked the sword—
units.displayText: She, she kicked it! She kicked the sword—

spans.text: She, she kicked it! She kicked the sword—

units.rawText: Hobbie! Everyone, run away—
units.displayText: Hobbie! Everyone, run away—

spans.text: Hobbie! Everyone, run away—

units.rawText: Having experienced the transforming power of the sword, the people present all feel their hearts jump into their throats.
units.displayText: Having experienced the transforming power of the sword, the people present all feel their hearts jump into their throats.

spans.text: Having experienced the transforming power of the sword, the people present all feel their hearts jump into their throats.

units.rawText: Everyone (bird included) scrambles to flee the sword and ducks behind cover as they await the flare of light.
units.displayText: Everyone (bird included) scrambles to flee the sword and ducks behind cover as they await the flare of light.

spans.text: Everyone (bird included) scrambles to flee the sword and ducks behind cover as they await the flare of light.

units.rawText: Huh? How come nothing's happened after so long? Is there going to be more experimental data now?
units.displayText: Huh? How come nothing's happened after so long? Is there going to be more experimental data now?

spans.text: Huh? How come nothing's happened after so long? Is there going to be more experimental data now?

units.rawText: Fern pokes her head out from her hiding place.
units.displayText: Fern pokes her head out from her hiding place.

spans.text: Fern pokes her head out from her hiding place.

units.rawText: Hehe—Don't worry, it's okay this time, I didn't trigger its effects.
units.displayText: Hehe—Don't worry, it's okay this time, I didn't trigger its effects.

spans.text: Hehe—Don't worry, it's okay this time, I didn't trigger its effects.

units.rawText: Wow, you moved so fast! Did the data overwrite mess up your neural cloud, Chanzhi?
units.displayText: Wow, you moved so fast! Did the data overwrite mess up your neural cloud, Chanzhi?

spans.text: Wow, you moved so fast! Did the data overwrite mess up your neural cloud, Chanzhi?

units.rawText: Heck no! It didn't even activate at all.
units.displayText: Heck no! It didn't even activate at all.

spans.text: Heck no! It didn't even activate at all.

units.rawText: Take a look if you don't believe me! I already wrapped the sword up with the ribbons beforehand so that sort of thing won't happen again.
units.displayText: Take a look if you don't believe me! I already wrapped the sword up with the ribbons beforehand so that sort of thing won't happen again.

spans.text: Take a look if you don't believe me! I already wrapped the sword up with the ribbons beforehand so that sort of thing won't happen again.

units.rawText: Whew... Thank goodness, you scared the crap out of me.
units.displayText: Whew... Thank goodness, you scared the crap out of me.

spans.text: Whew... Thank goodness, you scared the crap out of me.

units.rawText: How's that? Reliable, aren't I? I told you I wouldn't cause problems for you guys again!
units.displayText: How's that? Reliable, aren't I? I told you I wouldn't cause problems for you guys again!

spans.text: How's that? Reliable, aren't I? I told you I wouldn't cause problems for you guys again!

units.rawText: Chanzhi smugly flutters the ribbons in her hand.
units.displayText: Chanzhi smugly flutters the ribbons in her hand.

spans.text: Chanzhi smugly flutters the ribbons in her hand.

units.rawText: Whew... Well, the road she took had lots of ups and downs, but it seems Chanzhi really has become a little more reliable now.
units.displayText: Whew... Well, the road she took had lots of ups and downs, but it seems Chanzhi really has become a little more reliable now.

spans.text: Whew... Well, the road she took had lots of ups and downs, but it seems Chanzhi really has become a little more reliable now.

units.rawText: Hehe, she looks like a proper mythological figure now. If I'm not wrong, your costume is supposed to be that of one of the handmaidens of the Queen Mother of the West, right?
units.displayText: Hehe, she looks like a proper mythological figure now. If I'm not wrong, your costume is supposed to be that of one of the handmaidens of the Queen Mother of the West, right?

spans.text: Hehe, she looks like a proper mythological figure now. If I'm not wrong, your costume is supposed to be that of one of the handmaidens of the Queen Mother of the West, right?

units.rawText: I think so. I look just like how the grandpas and grandmas described them!
units.displayText: I think so. I look just like how the grandpas and grandmas described them!

spans.text: I think so. I look just like how the grandpas and grandmas described them!

units.rawText: Hahaha. Look, Slo-Mo likes your ribbons, too. See, it's chasing them around.
units.displayText: Hahaha. Look, Slo-Mo likes your ribbons, too. See, it's chasing them around.

spans.text: Hahaha. Look, Slo-Mo likes your ribbons, too. See, it's chasing them around.

units.rawText: Pfftt, it's just like a little doggy. It's so cute.
units.displayText: Pfftt, it's just like a little doggy. It's so cute.

spans.text: Pfftt, it's just like a little doggy. It's so cute.

units.rawText: Indeed he is. I'll make a new dust cover for him next time, then.
